title: Capacitance Extraction via Machine Learning with Application to Interconnect Geometry Exploration
extraction_scope: Sections V–VI; Table IV and Figures 14–16 visually checked on PDF page 8.

identity.status: exact title and three authors match program after punctuation normalization; author-lab publication list identifies ICCAD 2025

mechanism: Layout cross-sections become geometry features labeled by a 2D field solver. Layer-specific models use DNNs for thickness-sensitive M0 cases and LightGBM elsewhere.
conditions: 94 imec N2 predictive-PDK cells; M0 training thicknesses 22–58nm step 6; testing 18–62nm step 2. Dual Intel 6454S, 89 training threads. Per-cell pattern/inference times 0.082/0.803 seconds exclude database construction and tuning.
holdout_review: 38nm is called unseen but Section VI.A uses it for hyperparameter-selection loss. Not a demonstrated untouched test; no proof of direct training leakage. Errors increase near range boundaries.
limits: Predictive-PDK evaluation is not silicon validation or demonstrated cross-library transfer.
Fast inference does not establish amortized end-to-end DTCO acceleration.
next_action: Code the surrogate mechanism; capture original abstract; audit split/model-selection protocol and amortization before accepting generalization or speedup.
